executed_script.availability: Preserved local artifact; not included in the repository

invocation_shim: Native classes, constructors, validate_code and run_round are invoked. CodeArena.get_environment is replaced with an offline Docker wrapper; lightweight player records expose name/environment. This is a native reference suite, not a complete tournament or agent workflow.

publication_script.changes_since_execution: Clarified tournament simulations versus validation probes and get_environment shim; formatted code; required explicit CLI paths; reject existing attempt directories and empty catalogs before launch; require every worker exit code to be zero. Native validator/check logic unchanged.

new_regressions: Existing passing reports cannot be reused as a new run

reproduction.notes: Use a fresh output directory: existing attempt paths are refused. All reference programs are the pinned starter submissions; no special winning program or simplified benchmark task is introduced.
reproduction.python_environment: Separate native CodeClash environment with mini-swe-agent 2.4.2 and pinned CodeClash dependencies; do not import adapter codeclash package
reproduction.requires: 21 local codeclash-adapter/<arena>:f0694c64ecf6 images with verified source/arena labels and matching catalog commits; builds are not performed by this script

scope: Native validator and forfeit reference validation; not a winning oracle or real-model parity
simulation_scope: Native validation can run genuine engine probes. Zero tournament simulations applies only to the two forfeit controls, where native run_round skips execute_round. The original raw report field game_simulations referred to this narrower quantity.
